notes: Verifier K, wave 4. Printed: 'Vigilance, protection from multicolored'. Expectation from the text: vigilance, so attacking does not tap it (CR 702.20b); protection from multicolored means it can't be blocked by multicolored creatures (CR 702.16f), so the white-blue Gold Imp is never offered a block, while the mono-red Red Imp may block it, and the red Imp's 1 combat damage is dealt (a mono-coloured source is not covered).
